tools.name: execute-task
tools.title: Execute PI Task
tools.description: Execute a PI coding task from a caller-supplied prompt and model and persist its provider session behind an opaque continuation handle.

prompt.description: Prompt to execute with PI. The caller builds the final prompt and optional model.

model.description: PI model identifier selected by the caller.

tools.name: continue-task
tools.title: Continue PI Task
tools.description: Continue a previously completed or failed PI task through its opaque Ploinky continuation handle.

handle.description: Opaque continuation handle issued by a PI task whose provider session was created.

prompt.description: New user message to execute in the existing PI session.
